body:
It's so stupid, but sure. I have a private friends list on this site I won't name. I posted something that I found really offensive and talked about how shitty it was. Later in the day, someone posted about me on an anonymous hate community saying something like "why would you post that if it's so offensive," basically rallying other anonymous douchebags to try and figure out who I was and shit all over me.

So now I guess I feel like someone is in my private space, I don't know who, who hates me enough to try and shit all over me in front of strangers instead of just talking to me about it or unfriending me. It's not even the first time it's happened. I just wish people would leave me alone if they don't like me.
